lessons.title: Lesson 1: Teen stress, school clubs and online forums
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: Teen stress, school clubs and online forums.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.term: Clauses of concession (Although / Even though / Though)
concepts.definition: Introduces a contrasting fact that makes the statement in the main clause surprising: Although / Even though + S + V, S + V.
concepts.example: Although he was under a lot of study pressure, he managed to stay positive.
concepts.essence: Shows unexpected contrast between two interconnected ideas.

rules.statement: Never use 'but' in the same sentence with 'although'
rules.meaning: In Vietnamese we say 'Mặc dù... nhưng...', but in English, you must NEVER use both 'although' and 'but' together.
rules.example: CORRECT: Although she prepared well, she felt nervous. (INCORRECT: Although she prepared well, but she felt nervous.)
rules.essence: Subordinating conjunctions and coordinating conjunctions cannot join the same pair of clauses simultaneously.

workedExamples.prompt: Combine the sentences using 'Although': 'He practiced sports hard. He did not win the gold medal.'
steps: Step 1: Place 'Although' at the beginning of the clause containing the effort.
Step 2: 'Although he practiced sports hard, he did not win the gold medal.'
Step 3: Ensure there is a comma separating the dependent clause and the main clause.
workedExamples.answer: Although he practiced sports hard, he did not win the gold medal.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using 'Although + but' in the same sentence.
commonMistakes.why: This is a direct word-by-word translation error from Vietnamese ('Mặc dù... nhưng...'). In English, use ONLY 'although' OR 'but'.
